definitions.explanation: To forcefully expel saliva from the mouth. Considered rude behavior in public.

definitions.gloss: to speak abusively; to hurl insults
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, to say something hateful or contemptuous.

notes:
The literal meaning is to spit saliva ({唾|つば}). The verb ⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧ extends figuratively to spitting out words — saying something harsh or contemptuous. In the figurative sense, the object changes from {唾|つば} to words like ⟦{暴言|ぼうげん}→暴言：12975_bougen⟧ (abusive language) or {悪態|あくたい} (insults).

The related expression ⟦{天|てん}→天：28464_ten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{唾|つば}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to spit at heaven) is a proverb meaning that insults directed at others will come back to harm oneself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{唾|つば}を{吐|は}く: to spit on the road
- ⟦{暴言|ぼうげん}→暴言：12975_bougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to hurl abusive language
- {悪態|あくたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to hurl insults
- ⟦{弱音|よわね}を{吐|は}く→弱音を吐く：15321_yowanewohaku⟧: to complain, to show weakness
